messages:
maria: Hey team, noticed Promo STACKED-APR applied twice on invoice INV-2026-0789; customer reports overcharge of $1,150. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.dev/INV-2026-0789
kevin: Can you attach the reconciliation CSV and the portal screenshot? I need to see whether it was automated stacking or a manual promo.
toni: Uploaded portal-screenshot.png and reconciliation snippet. billing@helixai.com is the contact. Looks like a promo overlap bug from the pricing experiment.
billing-bot: Alert: Invoice INV-2026-0789 flagged as promo_overlap. Case ID BILL-2026-0999. Invoice placed on manual hold.
maria: For policy, manual goodwill credits under $2k can be approved by finance lead. Kevin, approve $1,150 credit and tag GL 6501?
kevin: Approved. Code to GL6501, memo: "promo overlap credit per KEVIN approval; case BILL-2026-0999". Proceed and post today.
toni: Doing the journal entry now. Journal: Debit Sales Discounts GL6501 $1,150 / Credit AR $1,150. Will post and attach txn id.
maria: After posting, please update the internal billing ticket and add the customer-facing note. Also log the pricing-experiment id EXP-APR-07 for the engineering team.
tonii: Posted. Refund TXN: RFND-20260411-77. Invoice note updated; case BILL-2026-0999 resolved.
billing-bot: Case BILL-2026-0999 closed by user tonii at 2026-04-11T09:12:05Z.
maria: Thanks — I'll notif CS to confirm client received the credit.
kevin: Also loop in product on EXP-APR-07 so they can prevent further stacking.
maria: Filed issue in product tracker and pinged @product. Done."
